# 

    

    ![Twinmap Forever](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/main/docs/images/logo-light.svg)
  

**Your position on the map, in real time. In 2D or in 3D, even inside dungeons.**

An interactive map of World of Warcraft: Forever for your second screen.

  [![Latest version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/catubba/twinmap-forever?label=version)](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest)

![Twinmap on a monitor, a laptop, a tablet and a phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/main/docs/images/hero.png)

## Install in three steps

1. **The addon.** Install [Twinmap Forever from CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/twinmap-forever) and restart the game.
2. **The app.** [Download Twinmap for Windows](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest/download/Twinmap-Setup.exe) and open the file. It asks for no administrator rights and starts by itself. On a Mac or on Linux, download [Twinmap for Mac](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest/download/Twinmap-mac-arm64.zip) or [Twinmap for Linux](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest/download/Twinmap-linux-x86_64.AppImage): see below.
3. **Play.** The app finds your game and builds the map from your own game files, once, in a minute or two. Log in: your arrow appears on its own.

From then on the app updates itself, and the addon is updated from CurseForge.

**Windows says "Windows protected your PC"**

The installer is not signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may stop it the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. This happens only on the first download, not on updates.

You do not have to take our word for it: the code is all here, every release can be built from it, and every installer is scanned by [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/) when it is published. The result is in the notes of each release and in the badge at the top of this page.

**What you need, and installing by hand**

- Windows 10 or 11
- World of Warcraft: Forever
- The game running and not minimized while you use the map

The CurseForge app installs [QuestieDB](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/questiedb) with the addon: the data about NPCs, items and quests that the map reads. If you install the addon by hand, get QuestieDB too.

The addon is also attached to every release on GitHub, for addon managers that install from there, such as CurseBreaker and WowUp.

Every version of the app, with its notes, is on the [releases page](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases).

## macOS

Twinmap runs on Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 14 or later), with the macOS client of WoW: Forever.

1. [Download Twinmap for Mac](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest/download/Twinmap-mac-arm64.zip), open the zip and move **Twinmap** to **Applications**.
2. Open Twinmap. The first time, allow it under **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording**, then open it again.

Twinmap looks for the game in `/Applications/World of Warcraft` and `~/Applications/World of Warcraft`. Everything works as on Windows, pins and routes sent to the game included. Opened from Applications, the app updates itself, from version 0.19.0 on. Not on Mac yet: HDR.

The Mac app is signed and notarized by markus-barta, who builds it from the source of each release; every release checks that it holds the same code before attaching it.

## Linux

Twinmap runs on Linux (x86-64), beside WoW: Forever under Wine or Proton, through Steam, Lutris or Wine itself. The game must run on X11 or XWayland, as it does by default under Wine.

1. [Download Twinmap for Linux](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/releases/latest/download/Twinmap-linux-x86_64.AppImage), make the file executable (`chmod +x Twinmap-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, or Properties > Executable in your file manager) and open it.
2. Twinmap finds the running game, and its folder inside the Wine prefix, by itself. If it does not, choose the folder in Settings, Game and addons.

The AppImage updates itself in place, so your shortcuts to it keep working. Not on Linux yet: games running natively on Wayland, ARM computers and HDR.

## What it does

### 2D or 3D, one switch

One click turns the flat map into the land itself: mountains, valleys, coasts and rivers in relief, to turn, tilt and zoom, with your arrow, your quests and your route standing on the ground. In 2D and in 3D the map can turn with your character, as Rotate Minimap does in the game, or keep north up. Come close to a cave, a mine or Ironforge and the ground opens over it.

![Twinmap goes from the flat map to 3D with one click, down to Ironforge open inside its mountain](https://twinmap.app/media/3d.gif)

### Even inside dungeons

In dungeons and raids the arrow moves through the rooms, with the bosses marked and your companions beside you, each in the colour of their class. Open a dungeon's map from its door, before you go in.

![The arrow and four companions run through The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the bosses killed behind them](https://twinmap.app/media/dungeon.gif)

### Search an item, find who sells it

Search NPCs, items, quests, zones, dungeons and your own pins, with the distance on foot. An item is listed once for each vendor who sells it, the nearest first, and choosing one opens what that vendor sells and at what price.

![Refresh is typed in the search: the vendors of Refreshing Spring Water with their distance, and the wares of the nearest with their prices](https://twinmap.app/media/search.gif)

### Every character, with the game closed

Bags, bank, gear and statistics of every character you play, with a picture of each, and their professions, spellbook and talents. A filter leaves lit what you are looking for, and tells you which other character holds it.

![The Character workspace: what a character wears, its bags and its bank, another character chosen by name, and a filter](https://twinmap.app/media/items.gif)

### And more

- **Your own layout.** The tabs at the top are workspaces of panels. With Edit layout, put the map, Now, your bags or the auction house side by side, stack them or group them as tabs, and make workspaces of your own.
- **Your look.** Your arrow in any colour and size, the quest pins with Twinmap's icons, the game's or Questie's, and objectives as icons or as areas.
- **Shopping list.** Add a recipe or an item, and Twinmap says what is missing, where to get it and what it all costs, and shows the vendors on the map or puts them on your route.
- **In your language.** English, Français, Deutsch, Español (España), Español (Latinoamérica), Русский, 한국어 and 简体中文, the app and the addon, with the names of your game in its own language.
- **Auction House.** The prices of your character's auction house, every hour: what your bags, bank and gear are worth, how a price moved over a day or a week, and an alert when it crosses your line.
- **Your quests.** Where to hand in what is done and where to find what is left, for every quest of your log, with the XP and money each one gives. With Questie installed, the ones to take as well. It tells you which quests will soon give less XP, and can hide the ones that already do.
- **Services and resources.** Flight masters, inns, vendors, repair, trainers, banks, ships and zeppelins, ore and herbs, each one a layer you turn on or off. Ore and herbs go by kind too, and can hide what no longer raises your skill.
- **Caves and mines.** Zoom in on a zone and their galleries show through the ground, before you go in.
- **When you die.** The map marks your corpse, the graveyard and the way back on foot, or the door of the dungeon you died in.
- **From the map to the game.** Mark a point or build a route on Twinmap, and it appears in the game.

![The game on one monitor, Twinmap on the other](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/main/docs/images/second-monitor.png)

## On a phone, a tablet or a laptop

No second monitor? In the app, open **Settings**, turn on **Phone and tablet**, and scan the code with your phone. The map opens in its browser, in 2D or in 3D, with nothing to install. It works on your home network only, and only for devices that scanned the code.

![Twinmap on a phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/main/docs/images/phone.png)

## Good to know

**How it works**

Twinmap never touches the game's memory and never plays for you.

- **From the game to the app.** The addon draws a line one pixel tall at the edge of the game window and writes your position, your zone, your quests and what your character carries, wears and knows in the colors of its pixels. The app reads that line from the screen.
- **The map.** The app builds the map from the files of your own game, so it always matches your version of the game. No map is downloaded.
- **Inside dungeons.** The game does not tell addons where you are in a dungeon, so the app reads your place from the game's minimap on the screen. Keep the minimap visible, not rotating and zoomed all the way out.
- **The picture of your character.** When you open the character window, the app reads the picture of your character from the screen, as it does the minimap.
- **From the app to the game.** Points and routes go back through a few small files next to the addon, which the game reads by itself.
- **Your group.** The game tells the addon where your companions are. From far away it tells it only every few seconds, so in a group each Twinmap addon also tells the others where its own character is, through the game. Inside a dungeon the game tells nothing at all: there each Twinmap tells the group the place it reads from its own minimap.

**Optional addons: Questie and Shortest Path Forever**

None of these is needed. When one is installed, Twinmap shows more.

- [Questie](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/questie): the map shows the same quests Questie shows in the game, with the ones you can take. Without it, the map shows the quests of your log.
- [Shortest Path Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shortest-path-forever): the map shows the whole journey it plans, flights, boats and the tram included, on the floor the game guides you on, and what you send to the game is reached along the roads.

![The map draws back from Lakeshire until the whole journey to Ironforge shows, by gryphon and by tram](https://twinmap.app/media/journey.gif)

**Privacy**

- The app sends nothing by itself unless you turn on Help improve Twinmap, in Settings: it is off until you do. There is no account and no tracking.
- It connects to the internet to look for a newer version of itself, on GitHub; to fetch the prices of your auction house from prices.twinmap.app, about once an hour, asking for that house and nothing about you; when you press Send in the Feedback window; and, if you turn on Help improve Twinmap, to send anonymous data about the world of Forever. What is sent and where it goes: [twinmap.app/privacy.html](https://twinmap.app/privacy.html).
- The map on your home network is off until you turn it on.
- What the app keeps of your characters, their picture included, stays on your computer.

**What is planned**

Twinmap is young and it is being worked on all the time. New versions come out often, and the app updates itself.

Here is what is planned, in no particular order. These are plans, not promises: what you ask for can change them.

- **Group**: quests you share, pins everyone sees
- **Travel**: flight paths, your hearthstone
- **More on the map**: zones colored by level, the places you have explored, rares and treasures
- **Quests**: your whole quest log, chains, item rewards, and a plan for the session
- **Character**: experience per hour, reputations, a reminder when your trainer has something new
- **Alerts**: full bags, broken gear, a disconnected game, and why you died
- **Tools**: a macro builder, your action bars, a talent calculator, a screenshot gallery
- **Guides**: leveling guides that turn into routes on the map
- **Global shortcuts** and a **signed installer**

> **Photosensitivity warning.** The addon sends data by changing the colors of a one pixel line at the edge of the game window, many times per second. Its settings in the game can slow it down or pause it, and the pause button at the top of the app pauses it too.

## Feedback

Found a bug, or have an idea? In the app, **Feedback** sends us your message. You can also [open an issue](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/issues/new/choose) or write to dev@twinmap.app, in English or in Italian.

## Free and open source

All of Twinmap's code is in this repository, under the GNU General Public License, version 3. It is free to use, with no ads and no paid features, and it will stay that way.

**Anyone can contribute.** Report a bug, propose an idea, improve a text, or send a pull request with code. If you plan something large, open an issue first so we can talk about it before you spend your time.

Twinmap is made in spare time and costs nothing. If it is useful to you and you feel like it, you can [buy me a coffee on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/catubba). It is never needed, and it unlocks nothing.

**Build it yourself**

The repository holds both parts: `addon/` is the addon, `app/` is the desktop app (Electron, TypeScript, Svelte). You need Node.js 24.

```bash
cd app
npm ci
npm run dev    # run the app from the sources
npm test       # run the tests
npm run dist   # build the installer into app/dist
```

```bash
cd addon
npm ci
npm test       # run the addon in a simulated game
```

## License

Twinmap Forever is free software under the [GNU General Public License, version 3](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/blob/main/LICENSE). It comes with no warranty. It is built with the work of others, listed with their licenses in [THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES](https://github.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES).

Twinmap is a fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment, and Blizzard has not authorized it. It only reads what the addon draws on your screen and the files of your own game, and it never automates anything, but you use it at your own risk. World of Warcraft is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

releases.name: Twinmap 0.19.0
releases.notes:
### New

- **Twinmap on Linux.** Twinmap now runs on Linux beside the game under Wine or Proton (Steam, Lutris), on X11 or XWayland. Each release has it as an AppImage, beside the Windows and Mac downloads, and it updates itself. With two monitors, the game can be fullscreen on either. Thanks to markus-barta.
- **The shopping list on the map.** Under the list, Vendors on the map shows the nearest vendor of each item you are missing, in a gold ring, whatever the map filters. Add to route puts those vendors on your route, in the order to walk them. In the Professions panel, the + on a recipe adds it to the list. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Quests that will soon give less XP.** In Quests, in Now, a quest says "less XP at 22" when its XP drops at your next level or the one after, and "less XP" once it has. Its pin on the map says the same. Untick Low-level in Map filters to hide the quests to take that already give less XP. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Map icons.** Settings, Appearance, Map icons: the quest pins in Twinmap's style, with the game's own icons, or with Questie's when Questie is installed. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Objectives as areas.** Settings, Appearance, Objectives: Areas draws the objectives of each quest as an area in a colour of its own, round the places Questie gives for them. Thanks to Stalioot.

### Changed

- **The Mac app updates itself.** From this version, the Mac app opened from Applications looks for a new version as it opens and puts it in place, like the Windows app. With a Mac app of 0.18.0 or older, this one is still a download by hand.

**VirusTotal**: 0 / 66 engines flag `Twinmap-Setup-0.19.0.exe`. [Full report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/943007d845807f6928c025dece3822d2b00defe3900e8ac345cf709b3fdab95b).

releases.name: Twinmap 0.18.0
releases.notes:
### New

- **Workspaces, and Edit layout.** The tabs at the top are now workspaces, each a layout of panels that Twinmap keeps: Map, Character and Auction House to start, opened with Ctrl and 1 to 6. Click Edit layout, the icon after the tabs (or press Ctrl+E), to drag panels beside each other, stack them or group them as tabs, add panels from a list and close the ones you do not need. Make up to six workspaces of your own with +, rename one with a double click and drag it to move it. Reset this workspace and Restore default workspaces bring them back as they were.

![Edit layout, the icon after the tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catubba/twinmap-forever/main/docs/images/news/0.18.0-edit-layout.png)

- **Professions, Spellbook and Talents.** The Character workspace has them as panels beside Inventory: the level and recipes of each of your professions, the game's spellbook tab by tab, and the talent trees of your class with the talents you took. Every spell and talent shows the game's own tooltip.
- **Now, a block at a time.** Next stop, Attention, My pins, Quests, Nearby and Experience can each go into a panel of their own. The Auction House is in panels too: its search, the item, My items and the alerts.
- **Shopping list.** Add a recipe with the + on a profession trainer's window, or an item with the + of the search. The list says what is missing and where to get it (another of your characters, the nearest vendor and its price, the recipe that makes it, who drops it) and what buying it all costs, and it follows your bags and bank as you play. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Ships and zeppelins.** Every dock has its ship or zeppelin on the map: click one to see its way and where it goes, across the sea too. Turn them on or off with Ships and zeppelins in Map filters. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Your arrow, your colour.** Settings, Appearance, Arrow: any colour and a size from 75% to 200%, on the 2D map and in the 3D view. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **The Mac app as a download.** Each release now has the Mac app beside the Windows installer, on GitHub and on twinmap.app. Thanks to markus-barta.
- **Eight more bosses on the dungeon maps.** Eight bosses that had no pin on their dungeon map now have one, where the players who share data killed them.

### Changed

- **Items is now Character.** Bags, Bank and Inventory are panels of the Character workspace.
- **Quest objectives by kind.** Objectives near each other that ask the same thing are one pin, drawn by what they ask, with the number of quests at its corner. Point at a quest in Quests, in Now, to keep its pins lit and dim the others. Thanks to Stalioot.
- **A hidden map rests.** The map stops drawing while no workspace shows it.
- **Fewer wrong places in dungeons.** A place found anew is let go when rooms the game always draws from there are not on the minimap.

### Fixed

- **Your arrow inside dungeons.** Since 0.17.0, standing still for a few seconds in a dungeon could make Twinmap read the wrong part of the screen and lose your character. It reads the minimap again.
- **The Filters menu on a short map.** It stays inside the map however low its panel.

**VirusTotal**: 0 / 66 engines flag `Twinmap-Setup-0.18.0.exe`. [Full report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/d23d274cdd45f7b9b2d10052b61b9fe3a15dffa07921e4190f1de3c44c0d48de).

SHA-256: `d23d274cdd45f7b9b2d10052b61b9fe3a15dffa07921e4190f1de3c44c0d48de`

releases.name: Twinmap 0.17.0
releases.notes:
### New

- **Twinmap on Mac.** Twinmap now runs on Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 14 or later) with the macOS client of WoW: Forever. A download for Mac follows soon; until then the README on GitHub says how to build it. Thanks to markus-barta.
- **What's new.** After an update, Twinmap shows once what changed in the versions you skipped. Settings, About Twinmap, What's new shows it again.
- **Arrival times at your speed.** The time on the label of a point and on the band of the next stop now goes at your character's own speed, and on a mount it says so: "0:50 mounted". Thanks to Stalioot.
- **Metres.** With Twinmap in English or Chinese, Settings, General, Distances writes distances in metres. The numbers stay the game's own, as in the game's clients in other languages: only the unit changes.
- **The line on the side of the game.** In the addon's options, Position now has Left edge and Right edge too, for setups where the top of the game window is covered or off screen, such as a game stretched over two screens.

### Changed

- **Settings in a window.** Settings opens over the map, with its categories in a column on the left. Every choice is one row, and the side of the map is now in Appearance.
- **Layers is now Filters.** The button at the top of the map and its menu have a clearer name. The L key still opens it.

### Fixed

- **Followed in dungeons with the minimap in the corner.** With a minimap of some widths right against the top right corner of the screen, Twinmap did not follow your character inside dungeons. It does now.
- **No more "addon older than this app" by mistake.** A line read while the game was redrawing it could make Twinmap say the addon was too old, with the same version on both sides. Twinmap now believes only a line that checks out.

**VirusTotal**: 0 / 66 engines flag `Twinmap-Setup-0.17.0.exe`. [Full report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/24cf1bdf07c7dd22a431fe000e47aeca64852dc218f747d5930d1bea16e7ffdf).

SHA-256: `24cf1bdf07c7dd22a431fe000e47aeca64852dc218f747d5930d1bea16e7ffdf`

releases.name: Twinmap 0.16.1
releases.notes:
### New

- **Ore and herbs by kind.** In Layers, the arrow beside Ore and beside Herbs opens the list of their kinds, each with the skill it asks, coloured as the game colours it for your Mining or Herbalism. Turn off the kinds you do not want on the map, or tick Hide grey to hide what no longer raises your skill: the list follows you as you learn.
- **Each herb its own icon.** Herbs on the map show their own picture on a dark disc, so Peacebloom and Silverleaf are told apart at a glance.
- **Quest rewards.** The tooltip of a quest icon shows the XP each quest gives your character, and the money it pays for the quests your game has already seen.

### Fixed

- **Ore and herbs in other languages.** With the game in a language other than English, most veins and many herbs were missing from the map since 0.16.0. They are all back, with their names in your game's language.

**VirusTotal**: 0 / 64 engines flag `Twinmap-Setup-0.16.1.exe`. [Full report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/d74200e07a768f179614f4b1e572257191185b570b90f536cc2d499f937b0a36).

SHA-256: `d74200e07a768f179614f4b1e572257191185b570b90f536cc2d499f937b0a36`

releases.name: Twinmap 0.16.0
releases.notes:
### New

- **Twinmap in eight languages.** English, Français, Deutsch, Español (España), Español (Latinoamérica), Русский, 한국어 and 简体中文: every text of the app and of the addon, written with the words your game uses in each. The first run asks which one, Twinmap asks once after this update if your game is in one of them, and Settings, Language, changes it at any time. If something reads wrong in your language, tell us with Feedback.
- **Names in the language of your game.** Zones, places, quests, NPCs, items, bosses and professions come in the language your game is set to, also when Twinmap speaks another, and the search finds them as the game writes them.

**VirusTotal**: 0 / 66 engines flag `Twinmap-Setup-0.16.0.exe`. [Full report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/30e7c967570d750dfea5f07623bf6509a99ace1cc135d789f50c7da7ced1a768).
